title: Next Closest Time
description: Find the next closest time using the current digits from a given time string 'HH:MM'.
pseudocode:
1. digits = time.split('') 
2. allowed = sort unique digits 
3. for h1 in allowed: 
4.   for h2 in allowed: 
5.     for m1 in allowed: 
6.       for m2 in allowed: 
7.         time = h1h2:m1m2 
8.         if valid and time > input: return time
